mapper.sql: smd.sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} and smd.use_yn = 'Y' and smd.delete_yn = 'N' and smd.sold_out_yn = 'N' and smm.use_yn = 'Y' and smm.delete_yn = 'N' and ( smd.option_use_yn <> 'Y' or not exists ( select 1 from store_menu_option_group required_group where required_group.link_sys_id = smd.sys_id and required_group.sys_plant_cd = smd.sys_plant_cd and required_group.use_yn = 'Y' and required_group.delete_yn = 'N' and required_group.required_yn = 'Y' and not exists ( select 1 from store_menu_option_detail available_option where available_option.link_sys_id = required_group.sys_id and available_option.sys_plant_cd = required_group.sys_plant_cd and available_option.use_yn = 'Y' and available_option.delete_yn = 'N' and available_option.sold_out_yn = 'N' ) ) )
mapper.select: select smm.sys_id as category_sys_id, smm.category_name, smd.sys_id as menu_sys_id, smd.menu_name, smd.menu_price, smd.menu_description, smd.option_use_yn, smd.sold_out_yn from store_menu_detail smd inner join store_menu_master smm on smm.sys_id = smd.link_sys_id and smm.sys_plant_cd = smd.sys_plant_cd where order by smm.ord_no asc, smd.ord_no asc, smd.sys_id asc

select smd.sys_id as menu_sys_id, smog.sys_id as option_group_sys_id, smog.group_name, smog.required_yn, smog.input_type as selection_type, smod.sys_id as menu_option_sys_id, smod.menu_option_name, smod.menu_option_price, smod.menu_description as menu_option_description, smod.maximum_num, smod.default_yn, smod.sold_out_yn from store_menu_detail smd inner join store_menu_master smm on smm.sys_id = smd.link_sys_id and smm.sys_plant_cd = smd.sys_plant_cd inner join store_menu_option_group smog on smog.link_sys_id = smd.sys_id and smog.sys_plant_cd = smd.sys_plant_cd and smog.use_yn = 'Y' and smog.delete_yn = 'N' inner join store_menu_option_detail smod on smod.link_sys_id = smog.sys_id and smod.sys_plant_cd = smog.sys_plant_cd and smod.use_yn = 'Y' and smod.delete_yn = 'N' and smod.sold_out_yn = 'N' where and smd.option_use_yn = 'Y' order by smm.ord_no asc, smd.ord_no asc, smog.ord_no asc, smod.ord_no asc, smod.sys_id asc
